test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: How long will it take a sum of money invested at 6% p.a. on simple interest to increase its value by 50%?
solution:
**Given:**

Rate of simple interest = 6% p.a. 

**Formula used:**

Amount = Principal + Simple interest 

Simple Interest = Principal × Rate/100 × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the principal be 100p

Amount = 100p + 100p × 6/100 × Time 

⇒ 150p = 100p + 100p × 6/100 × Time

⇒ 150p - 100p = 6p × Time 

⇒ 50 = 6 × Time 

⇒ Time = 50/6 

⇒ Time = 25/3 years or 8 (1)/(3) {years}

**∴ The required time is 8 (1)/(3) years.**
